finding: National Archives revolutionary-trial presentation states that in spring 1960 Choi In-gyu proposed in Cabinet a six-member group consisting of Interior, Justice, Agriculture, Defense, Communications and Transportation ministers, with Cabinet agreement to mobilize civil servants and families. This corrects the prior lead that described a 1959 group including Finance. Exact meeting date and original Cabinet minutes remain open.
